title: feat(plugin-report): the report page exports the drawn table as CSV / XLSX (exportOptions)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AW2QBu332oFgX78Gj9kfg9)_
Refs #25873 (item: the report page reads exportOptions)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:报表页右上角新增「导出」按钮,可把页面上画出来的那张表(含合计行/合计列)下载为 CSV 或 XLSX;`exportOptions` 从 planned 翻为 live。
- 为什么改:裁决 6408567749 选 B(时间范围 + 导出);spec 半边 #26548 已发布 `exportOptions`,但没有渲染器读它,报表无法带去开会。
- 风险与回滚:只影响非 joined 报表页的表头一行;权限沿用列表的 `export` 操作判定,无提供者时照列表默认放行;回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx`(权限判定与文件写出),`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` 两处快照块,`packages/spec/liveness/report.json` 的 exportOptions 子树。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.export-25873.test.tsx`,预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **New module `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx`.** `ReportExportControl` draws an Export popover offering the declared formats (absent = CSV and XLSX in that order, `formats: []` = no control). It reads the report's `exportOptions`, `label` and `name`.
- **What is exported is the table as drawn.** `DatasetReportTable` (tabular / summary) and `DatasetMatrixTable` build a snapshot of exactly the cells they render (header labels, rows in layout order, server totals row and totals column) and hand it up through `ReportTableSnapshotContext`, keyed on content, not identity (ui AGENTS #10). The download re-queries nothing and re-aggregates nothing, so it inherits the table's own `runtimeFilter` and, once #27070 lands, its period.
- **Who may export.** The control is drawn only when the viewer's effective API operations on the dataset base object (the query answer's `object`) include `export`, the list toolbar's predicate, read through `usePermissions().getObjectApiOperations` from `@object-ui/permissions`. An absent set (no provider, an unrestricted object) keeps it, as on the list.
- **Files.** CSV: drawn text, UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, RFC 4180 quoting, CRLF rows; a dimension cell opening with a formula character gets the tab guard `ReportExportEngine` uses (a formatted measure keeps its minus); the tab guard applies to data cells and to every header cell (a matrix's across headers are data values). XLSX: one sheet named for the report, header bold, measure cells as numbers, dimension cells as drawn text; ExcelJS is `import()`ed only when an XLSX is asked for. File name = `buildExportFileName` from `@object-ui/core` (the list export's builder): `fileNamePrefix`, else the report label, else the name, plus a local timestamp. `includeHeaders: false` drops the header row.
- **Not read on `joined`** (the spec refuses `exportOptions` there): the joined branch mounts no snapshot context, so its blocks publish nothing and no control is drawn.
- **Dependencies.** `@object-ui/plugin-report` now depends on `@object-ui/permissions` (`workspace:*`) and `exceljs` (`^4.4.0`, the version `@object-ui/plugin-grid` already pins); `pnpm-lock.yaml` gains the importer lines only (+6).
- **Liveness.** `packages/spec/liveness/report.json` `exportOptions` subtree flipped to `live` citing `ReportExport.tsx#ReportExportControl`, `authorWarn` / `authorHint` dropped in the same edit; `state-counts/report.md` regenerated (`gen:liveness-counts`).
- **Lint liveness pin** (`packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`, the #26548 block, seat-accepted deviation): rewritten as a silence pin for `exportOptions` with an anti-vacuity read of the live row; `dateRange` still warns in the same call, so the ledger is proven loaded.
- Changeset `.changeset/25873-report-export.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-report` patch.

## Why

Ruling 6408567749 on #25873, letter B: "A, plus CSV / XLSX export of the report table through the existing list-export permission". The spec half shipped in #26548 (PR #26628); until this PR no renderer read `exportOptions`, so the key was inert.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.export-25873.test.tsx`, 12/12:

- CSV of a summary report equals the rendered table cell for cell (header row, rows, `Total` row), formula guard on the data cell only, file name from the label.
- absent `formats` offers CSV and XLSX; `formats: ['csv']` offers only CSV; `formats: []` draws no control.
- a viewer whose `apiOperations` on the base object exclude `export` sees no control; CONTROL: same provider with `export` shows it; CONTROL: no provider shows it.
- `includeHeaders: false` drops the header row; `fileNamePrefix` names the file.
- XLSX parsed back with ExcelJS: sheet name, header, measures as numbers, total row.
- a matrix CSV equals the rendered cross-tab, totals column and row included.
- a matrix across-axis value opening with a formula character is guarded in the CSV header row.
- a joined report draws no control.

Ablation (at 54aa045b, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): deleting the predicate line in `ReportExportControl` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 7eae13a4 to b22beff9) turns exactly 1 of 11 red, the `apiOperations` refusal test; restored blob 7eae13a4 equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. No dist leg: the test imports the renderer by relative path.

## Acceptance notes

- **Serial with #27070 (slice 1).** Both PRs insert the first child of the report root div (its period chip, this Export control), both rewrite the #26548 block of the lint liveness test, and both edit `liveness/report.json` (disjoint subtrees) and its `state-counts/report.md`. Whichever lands second merges `main`: keep both children (ideally one header row: chip left, Export right), make the lint block a silence pin for both keys with another warned control (the #26619 pattern uses `object.externalSharingModel`), and rerun `gen:liveness-counts`.
- **File name and the period.** The spec TSDoc says the file is named for the report label and the period; on this base there is no period, so the name is label plus timestamp. Once #27070 lands, the period label can ride the builder's `viewLabel` slot; noted for whichever PR lands second.
- **XLSX number formats.** Measure cells are written as raw numbers; currency / percent display formats are not carried into Excel number formats (the CSV carries the drawn text).
- The export control and period are component state, not URL state; nothing addressable changed.

## Verification

Head `858f0fe5`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report run type-check && pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/ && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; plugin-report 29 files, 269 passed / 7 skipped; lint 110/110.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 83 families; `--ran` reconciliation: 82 run, all exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: not every package has `dist/` locally; CI runs it). First readings that were red and repaired on this branch: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (one-authority-per-exported-name: `ReportExportFormat` collided with `@object-ui/types`, renamed `ReportTableExportFormat`), `check:liveness` (state counts stale, regenerated), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3, control sha outside the shallow clone, fetched). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (0 new); eslint on the three touched plugin-report files: 0 errors (react-refresh warnings only, same rule the renderer already carries); `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI-owned.)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
